title: The streamed byte admission bounds the measured peaks on a three-rung ladder, and the in-process registry admits only one of two runs that together exceed a tier budget

fixture.region: 3D, uniform mesh 0.05 um, 4 CPML cells on every face, Yee sampling, FP32, 12 steps, memory_mode streamed
fixture.structure: smooth sphere of radius 0.3 um (width 0.08 um), permittivity 4 in air, scalar epsilon
fixture.source_and_monitors: Ez point source at (-0.3, 0, 0) um, standard Gaussian pulse (0.8 um, FWHM 0.5 fs, centre 0.5 fs, amplitude 100); point probes Ez (0.3, 0, 0) and Hy (0.2, 0.1, 0); full time history; objective sum of squared signals
fixture.policy: StreamedAdjointOptions(device=cuda, slab_width=8, temporal_depth=4, checkpoints=1, tile_transfers=sync) with state_storage host and disk (private scratch directory, disk_budget_bytes 4 GiB), gpu_budget_bytes 2 GiB, host_budget_bytes 16 GiB; one small warm-up run precedes the ladder so the CUDA kernels are loaded
fixture.instruments: report['forward_memory'] and report['backward_memory'] of torchfdtd/memory_accounting.py: peak_torch_allocated_bytes.delta_bytes (exact allocator peak after torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats before each rung), host_bank_bytes.bytes (SlabBlockOperator bank ledger), scratch_disk_peak_file_bytes.bytes (StateStore), peak_process_rss_bytes.delta_bytes (working set, informational)
fixture.registry: torchfdtd/reservation_registry.py: ReservationRegistry.acquire under one threading.Lock; StreamedSimulation forward and backward phases hold a lease on the host, gpu and disk tiers for the duration of the phase; the concurrency tests run the scatterer of tests/g5_support.py on CPU tiles with host and disk banks and a budget of 1.5 times one reservation

reference_method: the planner's own reservation (torchfdtd/streamed.py::_reservation) compared with the measured peaks of the same run; a bound check, not a physics oracle. The registry is checked by construction: two threads released together by a barrier, and a run blocked inside its first tile while a second run is admitted against the same budget

observables.name: gpu_ratio
observables.definition: gpu_reservation_bytes / max over phases of peak_torch_allocated_bytes.delta_bytes

observables.name: bank_ratio
observables.definition: host_reservation_bytes / peak host_bank_bytes for host banks; disk_reservation_bytes / peak scratch_disk_peak_file_bytes for disk banks

observables.name: gpu_margin_bytes
observables.definition: gpu_reservation_bytes minus the measured peak Torch allocated delta

observables.name: bank_margin_bytes
observables.definition: the tier reservation minus the measured peak bank bytes

observables.name: rss_ratio_informational
observables.definition: host_reservation_bytes / working-set delta of the phase; recorded, not a criterion: the working set also holds pinned staging, Torch host tensors of the caller, allocator arenas and runtime pages that the reservation does not model

acceptance.rule: on every rung and for both bank tiers, gpu_ratio >= minimum_ratio and bank_ratio >= minimum_ratio, with the allocator peak flagged exact; the measured peak Torch allocated delta never exceeds the measured peak Torch reserved bytes
acceptance.registry: of two simultaneous requests of 600 bytes against a 1000-byte budget exactly one is admitted and the other raises ValueError starting with 'Concurrent streamed reservation refused'; a request that overflows one tier registers nothing on any tier; a second StreamedSimulation run against a budget of 1.5 reservations is refused with that message while the first run is inside its forward phase, and is admitted after the first run finishes; a failed phase releases its lease
acceptance.scope_statement: the registry guarantee is per Python process and is admission, not a quota: it does not see other processes, does not limit later allocations of an admitted run and does not replace the live free-memory checks
acceptance.source_of_limits: G5-03 specification: the byte admission is matched against the actual peak (ratio at least one) and concurrent admission is atomic; the margin is recorded rather than bounded above because the reservation is a documented conservative bound (docs/STREAMED_FDTD.md)

not_yet_covered: a machine-wide (cross-process) reservation: the registry is per process by design and the scope is stated in the record
asynchronous tiles and ADE, geometry or density paths on the ladder (the ladder measures the dense scalar path)

notes: Declared before the recorded run on branch g5-memory from main 73203d2. A prototype of the ladder at this commit measured gpu ratios of 2.8 to 3.0, host bank ratios of 2.1 to 3.0 and disk ratios of 1.33; the working-set delta of the very first CUDA run in a process includes the kernel modules, which is why the ladder is preceded by a warm-up run and the RSS ratio is informational. The record is docs/validation/g5/G5-03.json.
